source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Unauthorized use of equipment
affected_asset_selectors: Ground: Production (Manufacturing/Assembly facilities & launch facility) & Satellite Control Centre & EGSE/MGSE
description: Unauthorized access to physical devices in scope of the satellite lifecycle, such as physical workstations, machinery in production/assembly facilities or launch facility, may allow the adversary to conduct multitude of nefarious activities with far reaching consequences for the satellite lifecycle.
